title: Karuppu Roja
desc: After falling in love, Vinodh manipulates Tulasi into marriage. However, once their first child is born, he kidnaps the infant, intending to sacrifice him to Satan in a bid to cure his mother.

title: Thulli Thirintha Kaalam
desc: Kausalya decides to teach a lesson to four irresponsible and lazy boys. However, she soon begins facing many difficulties while trying to discipline them.

title: Aan Pavam
desc: A young man lands in the wrong house with a marriage proposal and ends up falling in love with the girl. However, trouble begins to brew when the girl's real suitor turns up.

title: Chocklet
desc: Aravind, a college student, falls in love with a newcomer Anjali, unaware that she is the daughter of the Commissioner of Police and his acquaintance, Jayachandran.

title: Shahjahan
desc: Ashok, a young man who provides love advice to others, helps Raja woo a girl. However, he soon realises that she is none other than Uma, the woman he loves deeply.

title: Kilinjalgal
desc: When their parents disapprove of their relationship, Babu and Julie, two lovers belonging to different religious backgrounds, face several hardships.

title: Muyalukku Moonu Kaal
desc: A restaurateur loses his mind when his hotel gets trashed due to the act of a con artist. Later, the conman feels guilty about his action and decides to amend it.

title: Naanga
desc: Five college friends reunite after many years to help Devi, one of their friends who has woken up from a coma, get back with her lover, Babu.

title: Fillers
desc: A comprehensive compilation of promotional videos and trailers of Bollywood movies featuring popular actors and actresses.

title: Ninaivirukkum Varai
desc: A slum dweller falls in love with a wealthy woman who treats him like a friend. However, when he learns the truth about the man she is going to marry, he sets out to stop her wedding.
